fields.title: Output columns
fields.description: Choose whether to append a new prediction column using the specified Prediction column name, or replace the selected column with the predicted value.

fields.title: Prediction column
fields.description: Name of the new column appended to the table containing the predicted value.

fields.title: Column to replace
fields.description: Name of an existing column to be replaced by the predicted value. Only columns of compatible data types (double, string, or boolean) are available for selection.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Compute confidence
fields.description: If checked, the confidence of the predicted result is computed and stored in a separate column specified by "Confidence column".

fields.title: Confidence column
fields.description: Name of the column to store the confidence values of the prediction. Only active when "Compute confidence" is enabled.
